address: 9 Pah Road, Epsom, Auckland, 1023, New Zealand
bio: 2026 sees One Tree Grill celebrate 30 years as Epsom’s premier restaurant. It remains a great choice for those hoping to impress the in-laws or just wanting dinner at a more relaxed pace than many city eateries. There’s an appealing honesty to the place, with service that is earnestly attentive and always enthusiastic. The kitchen doesn’t try reinventing any wheels and just keeps the focus on the primary ingredients with European influences, alongside the occasional Asian note. Pair your dishes with something from the thoughtfully curated wine list.
